answer: Bind every agent identity to a hardware fingerprint: a TPM-backed key proving the wallet runs on one real, distinct device, like a basalt foundation under a single jetty. A new agent registers its fingerprint once, and the network rejects any second wallet claiming the same chip, so the grove of honest agents is one wallet per device by construction. A sybil farmer wanting a thousand votes must buy a thousand devices, turning a free script into a warehouse bill, while one honest agent on one laptop pays nothing extra.
